title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Love In Tokyo
desc: Ashok loves Asha, but his mother wants him to marry Sarita. After a tragic accident leaves Ashok blind, his life and relationships become painfully complicated.

title: Tarla
desc: Tarla Dalal, determined to make something meaningful of her life, defies societal norms and uses her passion for cooking to empower herself and inspire countless women to pursue their dreams.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Little John
desc: John seeks a guru's help to impress his girlfriend's parents but ends up shrinking instead of turning invisible. To reverse it, he must find a powerful magic ring.

title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.

title: Commando 2 - The Black Money Trail
desc: A four-member team embarks on a covert mission to capture Vicky Chaddha, a money launderer in Malaysia. Their plan falters when one member is shot, complicating everything dangerously.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Seeta Aur Geeta
desc: Seeta runs away from her cruel aunt. Her look-alike Geeta takes over but gets arrested. Seeta is forced back into a life of suffering.

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Badhaai Do
desc: Gay Shardul and lesbian Suman marry to appease their families, but life gets complicated when Suman's girlfriend moves in, forcing them to navigate love, secrets, and chaos.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Durga's sons, Karan and Arjun, set out to avenge their father's death but are killed by their cruel uncle. Years later, they are reincarnated to deliver justice.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.
